job.job_description:
Job Description

Must Have Expertise: 
• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile, Waterfall).
• Hands-on experience with different automation frameworks like BDD, TDD, Data Driven. 
• Hands-on experience with test automation tools (Playwright,Selenium, ).
• Programing Language: Python/Java
• API Testing Tools: Postman, Soup UI, Rest assured, Rest easy. 
• Sound knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) and security testing. 
• Familiarity with CI/CD tools and Cloud (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps). 
• Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
• Learning ability/Awareness to latest technology/Passion for technology.
OS (Windows/Linux) concepts
DBMS concepts & Ability to Write Queries

Good To Have Expertise:

AI tool exposure
• Knowledge of cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). 
• Big Data Technologies
• Cloud Technologies
• Document Based Database {MongoDB}
• Data Analysis

Soft Skills: 
• Strong leadership and team management abilities. 
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills. 
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
• Attention to detail and a proactive approach to quality assurance
